Located on the first floor, just a few steps from the sea, this two-room apartment is designed for those seeking the perfect balance between practicality, comfort, and a seaside atmosphere. The living area welcomes you into a bright and well-organized space where the open-plan living room and kitchen coexist harmoniously, creating an ideal environment for both everyday life and unforgettable vacation moments. Continuing towards the sleeping area, a hallway leads you to a functional bathroom and a spacious master bedroom. Completing the property is a pleasant terrace, an outdoor escape perfect for enjoying relaxation in fresh air while breathing in the sea breeze. Whether you're looking for your personal retreat or a strategic high-yield opportunity, this property represents true certainty. The enviable location and strong demand for tourist rentals in Jesolo Lido make it indeed a safe investment capable of ensuring excellent and consistent profitability over time. And to enjoy local life with complete peace of mind — or add unbeatable value to your rental market — there’s also an option to purchase separately a convenient private garage: truly a privilege for this Lido area.
